messages.subject: Execute renderUI within collapsed panel?
parts:
Hi everyone,

I was working on my shiny app with many inputs that are collapsed into several categories.
Since there are many input parameters, I would like to provide "sample" inputs.

Thing is, I don't think the input values are properly updated as long as they are collapsed.
If they are expanded (so that they became visible), I can see the inputs are set properly.

This is especially the case for those rendered by renderUI.
I can see the interface is prepared when I expand a collapsed menu.
(There is a time delay between expanding collapsed menu and a menu rendered by renderUI pops up)

I was wondering if there is any way to force shiny to execute certain UI regardless of its visibility.
(By setting env argument?)


My code is already too long, but to give some idea how I am writing:

in ui.R:
bsCollapse(id="FTissue", open="libraryPanel"
     bsCollapsePanel("Tissue type",
          uiOutput("TissueTypeS1"),
.....

in server.R:

output$TissueS1 <- renderUI({
       selectizeInput('TissueS1_choice', label = NULL,
           ....
       )
})

Thank you very much for your help in advance!


Sincerely,
Yongsoo

messages.author: 82d142d7d307fce9
messages.subject: Re: Execute renderUI within collapsed panel?
parts:
Hi Yongsoo,

using outputoptions, you can force shiny to execute an output object even if it's not visible.
https://shiny.rstudio.com/reference/shiny/latest/outputOptions.html

best,
Ger
